effect_description_eng:
[On Play] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, for each Digimon your opponent has in play, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.).
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] While your opponent has 2 or more Digimon in play, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
